answer_1.quote: Neural based end-to-end frameworks have achieved remarkable success in speech-to-text tasks, such as automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech-totext translation (ST).
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates text outputs from speech input in the form of transcribed text (ASR) and translated text (ST).

answer_2.quote: The ASR quality is measured with word error rate (WER), and the ST quality is reported by case-sensitive detokenized BLEU, which is based on the default SACREBLEU options.
